name: Hino Shouta
source:
Shouta is a first year student at Honoue Academy.
He has been teased by his older sister, Eimi, since he was a child. 
In order to go to a different school than his sister, he studied very hard but because of bad luck he still ended up in the same school as his older sister. 
To make it worse he was forced to join the same club as Eimi too.
Since then he accepted his fate to get teased at school and is depressed. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1184906&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
